Since settings.xml has the mirror disabled, Maven defaults to Central for everything. I need to either: 1) Add a repository definition to the pom.xml that points to a local repository, 2) Re-enable the Nexus mirror but make it not fail when unreachable, or 3) Add a repository to pom.xml that uses file:// protocol pointing to the local .m2 repository.
Plan: I'll add a repository definition directly in the pom.xml that tells Maven to look in the local .m2 repository for com.internal artifacts. This will allow the build to find the locally installed payment-utils without needing the Nexus server.
